accepted: I intend to study for a cloud certification.
I'd like to study for a cloud certification.
I would like to study for a cloud certification.
word-choice.s1.why: Pretend é fingir. Para falar de intenção, use plan to ou intend to; as duas opções são naturais.

accepted: We did a migration of the whole database.
We ran a migration of the whole database.
word-choice.s2.why: Realize é perceber. Para dizer que executamos uma migração, use carry out, do ou run.

accepted: We conducted a code review before merging.
word-choice.s3.why: A combinação mais natural é do a code review. Em contextos mais formais, também se diz conduct a code review.

accepted: I went to a conference about security last month.
word-choice.s4.why: Attend é comparecer a um evento; assist é ajudar alguém. Também podemos dizer go to a conference.

accepted: I had a question about the architecture.
I raised a question about the architecture.
word-choice.s5.why: Para formular uma pergunta, use ask a question. Had a question e raised a question também são naturais aqui.

accepted: I was at the security review meeting yesterday.
I joined the security review meeting yesterday.
word-choice.s6.why: Attend é comparecer a uma reunião; assist é ajudar alguém. Was at e joined também funcionam neste contexto.

accepted: At present, our team has six developers; last year it had three.
Right now, our team has six developers; last year it had three.
word-choice.s7.why: Aqui há uma comparação com o tamanho atual do time. Actually significa “na verdade”; currently, at present e right now significam “atualmente”.

accepted: The analyst intended to add tracing next sprint.
The analyst meant to add tracing next sprint.
word-choice.s8.why: Pretend é fingir. Para indicar intenção, use plan to, intend to ou mean to.

accepted: I did the nightly benchmark before release.
I executed the nightly benchmark before release.
word-choice.s9.why: Para dizer que executou um benchmark, use run, do ou execute.

accepted: Our team sometimes reviews dependency updates every few months.
Our team periodically reviews dependency updates every few months.
word-choice.s10.why: Occasionally, sometimes e periodically descrevem algo que acontece de vez em quando. Eventually significa que algo acontece depois de um tempo.

accepted: Our team sometimes reviews dependency updates as part of its regular maintenance work.
Our team periodically reviews dependency updates as part of its regular maintenance work.
word-choice.s11.why: Occasionally, sometimes e periodically descrevem algo que acontece de vez em quando. Eventually indica que algo acontece depois de um tempo.

accepted: We conducted research before selecting the vector database.
word-choice.s12.why: Para falar de fazer pesquisa, use do research. Em um registro mais formal, conducted research também é natural.

accepted: The presenter went to the security conference last month.
word-choice.s13.why: Comparecer a um evento é attend ou go to; assist significa ajudar alguém.

accepted: The lead informed the developers that the review was postponed.
The lead told the developers that the review was postponed.
word-choice.s14.why: Com a pessoa logo depois do verbo, use tell. Inform também funciona, geralmente com that antes da notícia.
